# INDEX

*Page PDF 126*

Sometimes his disguise slips when the paranoia overcomes him, and someone dies. Or an irresistible magical question comes up and he sets up a secret laboratory for a while. Kernethar thinks he has been able to keep his secret, but he is unaware that he has been discovered. In Marienburg, the spymaster Harzeth Duskmantle (see page 87) has discovered Malforic Silverblade’s real identity. He wonders whether to betray Grimwitch to Duriath Helbane or Myrrhven Silkblood, or turn the information to his own advantage. 

## **Kernethar as Patron**
While powerful, Grimwitch must be discreet to avoid capture. That means he needs agents — the more unwitting, the better — to accomplish his goals, whether to obtain sorcerous ingredients, gather funds he needs before moving on, or eliminate  someone who is coming too close. His paranoia poses a problem but, with good service, he may come to trust the Characters and reveal who he is. He might even become a mentor for a spellcasting Character, dangling forbidden knowledge before them — though betrayal is inevitable with enough time. 

## **Kernethar as Nemesis**
Kernethar Grimwitch can be a deadly enemy. Obsessed by his fear of Malerion’s agents, even a simple greeting or a random action could arouse his suspicions about a Character. Characters can encounter Grimwitch in several ways: they might be investigating a mysterious disappearance that turns out to be one of his experimental subjects, or an encounter with ‘Malforic Silverblade’ could lead to suspicions. Regardless, arousing Kernathar’s suspicions, something that is very easy to do, usually provokes him to flight. Should the Characters continually cross paths with the renegade, even unwittingly, he will take steps to neutralise them. Any Druchii is dangerous, and a paranoid Druchii doubly so.

## **Curiosity Killed the Wizard**
In marienburg, a chance meeting with sister Faasen of Heiligdom involved Kernethar in her attempts to cure mutation. Her goals are irrelevant to him, but the availability of so many test subjects for his research proved irresistible. staying longer than is wise, he has come to the attention of a witch hunter suspicious of Heiligdom. the Characters are hired either by Grimwitch or sister Faasen to drive him off. What happens when they learn why Kernethar is really helping the sister? and what if sister Faasen learns her adviser is a druchii?
